scenes.scene: Bathroom tiled floor. Neet and Buddy sit side by side each in a separate loosely wrapped towel after bath, their heads and forepaws visible and feet supported. Neet looks solemnly insulted; Buddy innocently looks away while a pair of CLOSED nail clippers peeks from under his towel at his seated rump. No water spray, no humans, no speech or text.
scenes.anchor: “We are warriors,” Neet muttered. “Not cuddle muffins.”
scenes.alt: Freshly bathed Neet and Buddy sit in towels, with the closed clippers hidden beneath Buddy.

scenes.scene: Apartment by closed front door. Full-body standing Neet wears tiny baby knitted beanie between his two broad visible ears with a pompom, very serious. Buddy stands separately looking toward him with amused relaxed open mouth; a small tipped pot and scattered soil lie next to Buddy, intact houseplant. All eight paws grounded distinct. No notice, no people.
scenes.alt: Neet regards the spilled plant solemnly while Buddy admires his pom-pom disguise.

scenes.scene: Low wide view of apartment open front doorway JUST AFTER failed dog costume collapsed. Neet and Buddy now both safely planted on all four paws separately on apartment floor with a crumpled oversized old hoodie and broom lying between them; three unused glue sticks near wall. Both dogs look up startled at manager in hallway, shown only two trouser legs and shoes cropped at knees in far background. No stacked dogs, no levitating paws, no pee yet. Comedy of two visible dogs exposed after one-dog disguise. No notice or text.
scenes.anchor: The hoodie settled between two very separate dogs.
scenes.alt: The Todd disguise collapses at the doorway, exposing two startled dogs to the manager.

scenes.scene: Apartment interior, ficus in broad pot left foreground. Neet sits naturally behind pot, wearing small dark sunglasses, head and full narrow torso visible through side gap, lowering muzzle toward shallow beef-broth bowl ON FLOOR, not holding cup. Through open doorway right background Buddy stands full-body greeting a mail carrier shown only hand holding envelopes and trouser leg. No notice. Warm domestic light, espionage contrast to friendly Buddy.
scenes.anchor: Neet monitored it all from behind a ficus, wearing sunglasses and sipping beef broth like it was whiskey.
scenes.alt: Neet shelters behind the ficus with his broth while Buddy conducts friendly public relations.

scenes.scene: Warm evening apartment stairwell landing; Buddy stands waiting on flat bottom landing looking affectionately at Neet who has just reached the SAME flat floor beside him, bodies clear and nonoverlapping, heads close with gentle shoulder bump. Stair flight visible behind and empty. Both have simple collars and loose leashes going upward out frame to unseen human. No sign, no notice, no text. Quiet friendship payoff, no hats or props.
scenes.alt: Buddy meets Neet at the bottom of the stairs for their shared evening walk.

scenes.scene: Alternative continuity: Buddy alone at apartment lobby mailboxes executes polite sit-and-paw greeting BEFORE the rebuff. Natural dog sit supported haunches, one forepaw planted, other raised politely toward manager standing right, shown only beige coat bottom, trousers and shoes cropped at waist; manager arms crossed edge visible. Buddy hopeful small pant smile. Neet absent. No urine, no notice yet, no readable text.
scenes.anchor: He intercepted Mr. Grubbs one afternoon near the mailboxes and executed a flawless sit-paw-smile combo.
scenes.alt: In the alternative, Buddy offers the manager his best diplomatic paw beside the mailboxes.

scenes.scene: Separate alternative continuity with female Neet. Apartment corridor, dry crumpled brown leaf under Neet near forepaw, she freezes startled with all four feet contacting floor, looks off frame toward unseen manager. Buddy halfstep ahead turns his head back with open mouth about to call RUN, four paws grounded. Clearly separated continuous bodies and loose collar leashes trailing clear of feet toward unseen human. Nearby open apartment door is escape route; a plain notice paper attached door has faint unreadable gray lines. No hats or backpack, no primary continuity. No speech text.
scenes.alt: In the alternative, a crunchy leaf betrays Neet as Buddy calls for escape.
